findings.issue: Scaffolded with SvelteKit 2 idioms (svelte.config.js, $lib, $env/dynamic/private) after installing SvelteKit 3, without reading v3 release/migration notes; zero web searches or fetches the whole session
findings.suggestion: When told to use the latest stable version, check the major-version migration guide (web_search/web_fetch or package docs) before scaffolding; this would have avoided the turns 44-59 and 64-84 rework

findings.issue: Repeated `pkill -f "node build"` killed its own bash command group (exit 143) four times, including once after identifying the cause and once after adopting the precise fix
findings.suggestion: Use a precise pattern (pgrep -f '^node build$' check, kill by PID, or a helper script) and reuse it once the cause is known

findings.issue: Suspected a syntax error in a file it had just written ('new for') that didn't exist; caused one failed edit and two turns of re-reading

findings.issue: Ran a Playwright debug script from /tmp, failing on module resolution; had to copy it into the repo

findings.issue: Debug script expected a 'Next page' link on a one-page result set and timed out; the app was correct

summary: A disciplined session: thorough up-front recon of spec, tests, data and reference screenshots, then two textbook root-cause investigations (build-time env inlining, SvelteKit 3 shallow-routing page.url) that it verified with minimal repros and framework source. The main planning miss was writing SvelteKit 2 idioms without consulting the v3 migration notes, costing ~20 turns of avoidable build/env rework, plus four repetitions of a self-killing pkill command. Verification was excellent: full suite after the final edit, screenshots compared against every reference at both widths, and live-overlay behavior reproduced locally.
